```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)


#----------------tick SETUP----------------
ticks <- read.csv("/usr4/ugrad/neochatt/TickForecast/Data/tickLong.csv") |>
  mutate(
    collectDate = as.Date(collectDate),
    year = year(collectDate)
  ) |>
  filter(scientificName == "Ixodes scapularis") |>
  filter(lifeStage == "Nymph")

deer <- ticks |>
  arrange(collectDate) |>
  group_by(siteID, collectDate) |>
  summarise(count = sum(processedCount)) 
deer$year <- year(deer$collectDate)
deer$DOY <- as.numeric(format(deer$collectDate, "%j"))

deer <- deer[deer$year > 2015, ]
deer <- na.omit(deer)

doy <- read.csv("/usr4/ugrad/neochatt/TickForecast/Data/DOYs.csv")

retreat <- read.csv("/usr4/ugrad/neochatt/TickForecast/Data/RETREAT.csv")

lat <- read.csv("/usr4/ugrad/neochatt/TickForecast/Data/UPDATED_FINAL_bounders.csv")

lat <- lat |>
  group_by(siteID) |>
  summarise(latitude = mean(c(latitude_top_left, latitude_bottom_right)))



#------------DAT setup-----------------
dat <- left_join(doy, retreat)

dat <- inner_join(dat, lat)

deer <- deer |> filter(siteID %in% unique(dat$siteID))


dat$mu_15 <- NA_real_


for(s in unique(dat$siteID)){
  
  mod <- lm(tick_15 ~ latitude,
            data = dat |> filter(siteID != s))
  
  dat$mu_15[dat$siteID == s] <- predict(
    mod,
    newdata = dat |> filter(siteID == s)
  )
}

#---------------------------------------------------

estim <- function(theta, data, shift){

  scale <- theta[1]
  
  x <- data$DOY - shift
  
  fitted <- ifelse(
    x > 0,
    dgamma(x, shape = 5, scale = scale),
    0
  )
  
  fitted <- fitted / max(fitted)
  
  sum((norm(data$count) - fitted)^2)
}

norm <- function(x) {
  return ((x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
}


for(s in unique(dat$siteID)){
  for(y in unique(dat$year)){
    
    temp <- deer |> filter(siteID == s, year == y)
    
    if(nrow(temp) == 0) next
    
    temp <- temp |>
      ungroup() |>
      add_row(DOY = 15, count = 0,
              .before = 1)
    
    
    shift <- mean(dat$mu_15[dat$siteID == s])
    
    fit <- optim(
      par = c(2, 15),
      fn = estim,
      data = temp,
      shift = shift,
      method = "L-BFGS-B",
      lower = 7.5,
      upper = 100
    )
    
    scale <- fit$par[1]
    
    DOY <- 1:365
    
    curve <- dgamma(DOY - shift,
                shape = 5,
                scale = scale)

    curve <- curve / max(curve)
    
    plot(temp$DOY, norm(temp$count), type = "l", main = paste0(s, y))
    lines(DOY, curve, col = "blue")
    
  }
}
```
